suspected. Although her neighbor tried to contact her son, he was not reachable.                                                        Commented [May7]: The use of ‘as a result’ is wrong here.

                                                                                                                                        because the next paragraph talks about her imaging results.

detected, and only few bruises in her right elbow were seen. To add, sShe was able to move                                              Commented [May8]: No comma.

without pain. start a new sentence here. A pelvis and hip X-ray did not show any fractures

but and all her imaging’s were unremarkable apart from osteopenia that was noted. TFT,

HbA1c and MSU tests were ordered, and they the results will be available tomorrow.                                                      Commented [May10]: No comma.


Consequently, she will be discharged today with nNo changes in were made to her regular                                                 Commented [May11]: You do not need to repeat this.


medications.

Doctor
